subject.title: feat(gateway): session dashboard domain — board RPCs, ticketed widgets, dashboard tool, per-agent persistence

question: Should v1 session dashboards support `mcp-app` widgets now, and if so what authorized descriptor-to-rendering contract should gateway clients receive?
rationale: The branch exposes `mcp-app` as a public board content kind but the visible snapshot and serving contracts do not establish a renderable representation; choosing whether to ship, defer, or narrow that public capability is a product and API-boundary decision.

options.title: Define and ship the MCP-app boundary
options.body: Add an authorized, renderable MCP-app descriptor or ticketed view contract and cover it with gateway/client integration proof before merging.

options.title: Defer MCP-app widgets from v1
options.body: Remove or reject the MCP-app board content variant for this release and merge only the fully renderable HTML-widget path.

options.title: Pause the feature boundary
options.body: Keep the PR open until the dashboard program settles how board widgets relate to the existing MCP-app rendering surface.

recommendation.title: Define and ship the MCP-app boundary
recommendation.body: Add an authorized, renderable MCP-app descriptor or ticketed view contract and cover it with gateway/client integration proof before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns the directly related merged UI board work and the proposed gateway contract.
